sources.title: TenStrip/MOSSkr2 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: This is an attn Q + K and MLP gate up groom using Krea2 on MOSS sft. It does not add data or weights and it doesn't make the model output like Krea2. It changes behavior in attention influenced by Krea2's attention like the other grafts.
